Prepare data for semifield Stan model

prepare_stan_data_semifield.Rd

Converts semifield experiment data to Stan-compatible list for the matched semifield model for a spatial repellent (Denz et al. 2021, doi:10.1186/s13071-020-04560-x ).

Usage

prepare_stan_data_semifield(data, prior_settings = NULL)

Arguments

data

List with the outcome matrices of matched experiments (one row per night, same night order in both arms):

  • y0: Control arm

  • y1: Intervention arm

Columns are H1, H2, H3, H4 (human landing catches in hours 1, 2, 3 and 4-12), T (trap) and L (lost). Without a trap, the T column can be left out (5 columns) and is then set to 0. Optionally, beta0 and beta1: trap availability per night in each arm (default 0, i.e. no trap, for a spatial repellent only). If the compartments contained a trap (e.g. unbaited), pass its availability, as in Denz et al. (2021), rather than leaving it at 0.

prior_settings

List. Optional prior hyperparameters (defaults as in Denz et al. 2021):

  • priorsigma_mean_logrates: Prior sigma for log rates (default: 6)

  • priorsigma_pikappa: Prior sigma for effect params (default: 5)

  • hierarchy: Variance for hierarchical effects (default: 1)

Value

List with elements for semifield Stan model.
